notes: ⚠ A MACHINERY-OF-GOVERNMENT CHANGE IN FY2026 MOVES THE ICT MANDATE AND ITS MONEY.** The section · names change in the enacted volumes: section 52 goes from *Postes, Télécommunications **et · Nouvelles Technologies de l'Information et de la Communication (PTNTIC)*** to plain ***Postes et · Télécommunications*** — the NTIC mandate is dropped — while section 71 goes from *Numérique* to · Économie numérique***. The money follows: section 52 falls **145,650,630,007 → 55,095,958,006 FC · (−62%)** and section 71 rises **60,627,481,411 → 226,713,223,741 FC (+274%)**. · Neither section's series can be read on its own across FY2025→FY2026**, and any statement about · "the digital ministry's budget" must say which section and which year. Combined, the two sections · are 219,729,663,315 (FY2024) → 206,278,111,418 (FY2025) → 281,809,181,747 (FY2026) FC, i.e. · 0.58% → 0.45% → 0.57% of the total budget** — so the headline jump in section 71 is substantially · a transfer, not new money. · The origin gate is printed in the volume.** The *développement par titre* separates · `Investissements sur Ressources Extérieures`** from **`Investissements sur Ressources Propres`**, · so the domestic share is the state's own disclosure and not an apportionment (driver → *Origin — · the double-counting gate*). The amount recorded here is the **section total less the external · investment group**. · ⚠ THIS IS A REVISED STAGE, NOT AN APPROPRIATION.** DRC published **no original enacted loi de · finances for 2025** — `/lois-de-finances/` stops at 2024 and `budget2025/vote/lf_2025_depenses.pdf` · returns 404. The only enacted FY2025 detail is the **rectificative** (n°25/044 du 28 juin 2025), so · `baseline_stage: revised` and **budget credibility cannot be measured for FY2025** — there is no · published figure for what parliament originally voted. On the acquisitions list. · The external investment excluded here is very large relative to the section.** FY2024: FC · 95,512,273,724 of a 132,595,229,324 section, i.e. **72% of the ministry's budget is external · investment**. FY2025: FC 105,512,273,724 of 145,650,630,007, i.e. **72%** again. Only the remainder · is recorded. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CDF/USD rate is held, and the driver · forbids spot-converting a fiscal-year figure.
